changes.reason: Allow an ordinary descendant commit to add only an omitted actual protected source path through an immutable original-digest-bound completion. Preserve independent original entry checks, exact real-Git source/parent/blob/mode and chronology checks, complete per-record effective coverage, source-binding equality and later merge dependencies. Reject overrides, duplicate or unchanged paths, incomplete aliases and changed originals; retain existing resolution-input supplement behavior.
